title: Rule health
description: Analytics rules collected from QRadar, with a health verdict derived from what has actually been observed. Building blocks are collected but are not listed here.
summaryNoticeTitle: {count} rules have no health verdict yet.
summaryNotice: A rule is INSUFFICIENT_DATA when it cannot be judged. That includes a dependency that has not been observed, and a window where QRadar exposes no last-fired time or the collection does not cover it. Neither is a detection gap. The health summary counts these rules together; the reason under each rule name says which cause applies to it.
empty: No rules collected yet. Run a rule sync to pull them from QRadar.

detail.title: Rule
detail.missing: This rule has not been collected.
detail.failed: Could not load this rule. Try again shortly.
detail.unestablishedFallback: No complete rule-metric observation covers this rule. Missing data is reported as unestablished rather than as a detection gap.
detail.noBuildingBlocks: No building-block dependencies were exposed by QRadar.
detail.noTelemetry: No log-source dependencies were exposed by QRadar.
detail.historyFailedTitle: The health history could not be loaded.
detail.historyFailedHelp: Nothing was changed, and this does not mean no evaluation was stored. Reload the page; if it keeps failing, check that the backend is reachable.
detail.historyEmpty: No rule-health evaluation has been stored yet.

statistics.title: Rule statistics
statistics.description: Inventory composition, measured matching load, proven silence and QRadar evaluation benchmarks.
statistics.noInstanceHelp: Register the QRadar instance in the platform configuration, then run rule inventory and rule-match collection before returning to this page.
statistics.failedTitle: Rule statistics could not be loaded.
statistics.failedHelp: The backend may be unreachable. Check that it is running, then reload this page; nothing was changed.

helpers.buildingBlockNote: QRadar's building-block list does not say whether the block tests events or flows.
helpers.lowerBoundMeaning: Flow matches are not searched, so this count proves the rule fired but may undercount.

capacity.heading: Capacity history
capacity.failedTitle: The capacity history could not be loaded.
capacity.failedHelp: Nothing was changed, and this does not mean the rule has no history. Reload the page; if it keeps failing, check that the backend is reachable.
capacity.emptyTitle: QRadar has not re-benchmarked this rule since collection began.
capacity.emptyHelp: A sample is stored only when QRadar reports a new benchmark time. This is not an error.
capacity.description: QRadar’s capacity benchmark: how fast the rule could be evaluated, so a lower figure is costlier. It is not a firing rate. Newest first, in UTC. Unit: {unit}.
capacity.unit: millions of events per second (QRadar's unit)
capacity.label: Capacity history
capacity.caption: Capacity benchmarks for this rule, newest first.

cost.heading: Costliest by benchmark
cost.emptyTitle: No enabled rule has a benchmark to rank.
cost.emptyHelp: The API returned no non-zero capacity benchmark for an enabled rule.
cost.label: Costliest rules by benchmark
cost.caption: Enabled rules ordered from the lowest capacity benchmark, which is the costliest to evaluate. Unit: {unit}.
cost.excluded: {count, plural, one {# enabled rule has no benchmark and is left out of this ranking.} other {# enabled rules have no benchmark and are left out of this ranking.}}

matched.heading: Most matched
matched.missingTitle: No complete window exists to measure rule matches.

matched.empty: No rule matched in the measured windows.

matched.captionRecords: Rules ranked by match records over the measured windows, with the match rate in events per second.
